metadata.title: Create Template File
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Complete template file with all sections

output.description: Complete template file with all sections

prerequisites: Template design completed (purpose, parameters, steps, flow diagram)
All referenced steps exist or are identified for creation
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: create file → write user docs → write flow → write steps → create JSON → validate
MD file contains: Description, Purpose & Usage, Quick Reference, Flow diagram, Steps list
JSON file contains: metadata, parameters, steps with full context, guidance
Each step's stepRef is the UUID from the step definition's id field, with stepRefName as human-readable companion
CRITICAL: Only create template files in this step. Do NOT create step files — missing steps are handled later by validate-flow-steps-exist via sub-flows
tools: write - Create template MD and JSON files
read_file - Read template design from memory
bestPractices: Always include continuous improvement as final step with approvalRequired: true
Use UUID-based references for all step and template cross-references
Keep parameters section clear with required vs optional
Ensure flow diagram matches step sequence
This step creates FLOW TEMPLATE files only (~/.claude/zeremai/templates/flows/). Step definitions are created as subdirectories within the template directory.

substeps.name: Create template file
substeps.description: Create the MD file in the templates directory

substeps.name: Write user documentation sections
actions: Write header comment with template name and purpose
Write Quick Reference table with parameters

substeps.name: Write flow diagram
substeps.description: Add mermaid flowchart showing flow flow
actions: Create mermaid flowchart matching planned steps

substeps.name: Write step definitions
substeps.description: Document all steps with their references
actions: For each step: checkbox, description, step reference UUID
Add continuous improvement as final step with approvalRequired: true

substeps.name: Create JSON companion file
substeps.description: Create the agent-facing JSON with complete step definitions
actions: Include metadata: type, id (UUID v4 as second field after type), name, category, title, purposeAndUsage
Include parameters: required and optional arrays

Include steps array with full context for each step -- stepRef must be the step definition's UUID, with stepRefName as human-readable companion; subFlowTrigger.template must be a template UUID with templateName as companion; loopBackTo uses step name strings; references.steps uses step definition UUIDs; references.relatedTemplates uses template UUIDs

substeps.name: Validate all sections
substeps.description: Verify template is complete and valid
actions: Verify all step references are valid

substeps.name: End-Step: Log Problems
substeps.description: Log what went wrong in this step
actions: Log problems: If any problems, errors, workarounds, or unexpected situations were encountered during this step, log them via add-log-entry --problems '["description of problem 1", ...]'. This feeds the continuous-improvement step's analysis.

flow.description: Linear flow: create file → write user docs → write flow → write steps → create JSON → validate

fields: Information Produced: Template file path, JSON file path, validation results
Files Modified/Created: Template MD file, JSON companion file
